Detective Handbook · How to Play

Find the eight changed details by tapping either picture. Correct finds earn 100 points. Incorrect taps use one of your 10 attempts but never remove points. Finish with fewer mistakes to earn a completion bonus.

Magnifying Glass: 2 uses each level. Activate it, then tap an area to inspect it at a larger scale. It does not count a difference as found. Clue Scanner: 1 use each level; it highlights an unfound difference in Picture B.

Ranks: Master Detective = 0–2 mistakes and at most 1 tool use; Skilled Detective = 0–5 mistakes and at most 2 tool uses; otherwise Rookie Detective. Complete each case to unlock the next case.
